info.title: Search FBT Inventory Record
info.description: This API is used to retrieve detailed inventory change records for goods at the warehouse level.

post.description: This API is used to retrieve detailed inventory change records for goods at the warehouse level.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Valid range: [1-100].

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination page token. It should be empty for the first page.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

goods_ids.description: The identifiers for goods generated by Fulfilled by TikTok system, maximum length 100. If specificed, it will only show inventory records belonging to those goods, otherwise, all goods with non-zero inventory will be returned.

fbt_warehouse_ids.description: The identifiers for warehouses generated by Fulfilled by TikTok system. If specificed, it will only show inventory records belonging to those warehouses, otherwise, all warehouses subscribed by merchant will be returned.

create_time_ge.description: Filter inventory record creation time to show only those that are created on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp in seconds. `create_time_ge` is 0 by default.

create_time_le.description: Filter inventory record creation time to show only those that are created on or before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp in seconds. `create_time_le` is the current time by default.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

id.description: The identifier for goods generated by Fulfilled by TikTok system.

reference_code.description: The identifier for goods defined by merchant.

goods.description: The reference used to track products and SKUs within Fulfilled by TikTok's network.

fbt_warehouse_id.description: The identifier for warehouse generated by Fulfilled by TikTok  system.

id.description: The identifier for order generated by Fulfilled by TikTok system.

type.description:
The type of order.
Possible values:
- INBOUND_ORDER
- RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER_ORDER
- DISPOSAL
- INVENTORY_STATUS_ADJUSTMENT_ORDER
- CONSIGN_ORDER
- INVENTORY_COUNT_ORDER
- FAILED_DELIVERY
- CUSTOMER_RETURN
- INVENTORY_QUANTITY_ADJUSTMENT_ORDER
- INVENTORY_TRANSFER_ORDER

order.description: The information of order that triggers current inventory change.

create_time.description: The time when the inventory record is created, Unix timestamp in seconds.

inventory_goods_type.description:
The type of goods in current inventory record.
Possible values: 
- NORMAL 
- DEFECTIVE

initial_on_hand_quantity.description: The number of goods units physically in the Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse before current inventory change, excluding those in transit.

final_on_hand_quantity.description: The number of goods units physically in the Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse after current inventory change, excluding those in transit.

changed_quantity.description: The change in the number of units is calculated as the `final_on_hand_quantity` - `initial_on_hand_quantity`.

inventory_records.description: A list of inventory records information.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

total_count.description: The total number of the search results.
